ticket.subject: ABSOLUTELY UNACCEPTABLE BUG!! MY CEO SAW THIS!! FIX RIGHT NOW!!
ticket.body: I AM LIVID! The settings button icon has a slight 2px padding misalignment on the top-right toolbar when viewed in Firefox dark mode! This looks completely unprofessional and our CEO noticed it! We demand this be prioritized as the highest emergency and fixed immediately or we will cancel our entire contract!
